title: Derive first-pivot Schur state weights from sector incidence
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Derive the first-pivot input multiplicities left open by the complementary-plane continuation handoff, using scalar sector incidence rather than the previous 496-split/GL4 census.

```text
h=0: four 11-sector incidence types -> 1,3,3,3
h=1: 27 one-dimensional type tuples x 6 realizations -> 126,18,18
published state order -> (1,3,126,18,3,3,18)
```

The binary scalar incidence-sum formula is proved for arbitrary sector dimensions; sufficient residual normal forms are proved only for profile (1,1,1,2). Input incidence, complete-header fibres, and centralizer multiplicities are kept distinct. Exact retained successor README bytes preserve Sagar Thakrar's continuation proof/table and credit; composing that credited premise recovers 93564 headers without claiming another continuation theorem or a new kappa.

## Validation

- **Before:** PR4689 enumerated the seven input weights; successor `93bebe5e1ad3dd17a97ae79f27e1a35edd3630aa` imported them explicitly. **After:** image/kernel incidence derives all seven weights, including the first weights 1 and 3 before centralizers enter.
- Registered normal and `-O` checks pass: 31 canonical tuples with actual invertible intertwiners, 30 dimension-two/three direct split controls, five semantic rejections, retained-byte authentication and exact output replay. No GL4 or full 496-split enumeration. Commit-byte/source-history and archive integrity checks pass.
- Credits retained: Mihir Srivastava #4689, ssafwann #4678/#4671, Sagar Thakrar, Nick Petalas #4915/#4597, MatShep, codyw912, Ryanson Jonathan, lee-phys, Cinna Davis and their cited lineage. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. Isolated research package; no selected result or existing code changes.

**Blast Radius:** research. The continuation numerical table is source-bound but not independently replayed here. General residual classification, physical header costs and supplier admission remain open. No Lean, Docker, production build or selected cold replay was run.

## Task and overlap

Refined task `b2_math_schur_split_incidence` on card `formal-interface-lemma`; [canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4653#discussioncomment-19140794). Scientific base `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`, priority revision7; refreshed canonical main is unchanged at the submission checkpoint. Exact dependency heads and retained source/path/hash records are in the scoped package. The claim states predecessor coverage, changed premise, live parallel exclusions and bounded stop rule. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are outside overlap coverage.

## Open next questions

See [the package questions](research/schur-split-incidence/README.md#open-next-questions) for the smallest remaining caller/interface obligation and its blocker. This contribution stops at the stated scoped result.

Reproduce with CPython3.12 on macOS arm64: `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/schur-split-incidence`. A separate Astra review of this exact HEAD found no actionable issue and reran normal/optimized targeted checks. Scientific review remains AI-assisted, not human or proof-kernel acceptance.
